cover_headline: 13 Lawmakers Seek Federal Probe Into Seattle Diwali Event Disruption
facts: All six Indian American members of the House signed the letter asking the Justice Department to investigate the Seattle Diwali disruption
The letter cites three federal statutes covering intimidation, conspiracies against federal rights, and obstruction of religious exercise
The lawmakers have asked the Justice Department for a briefing by December 4

end.headline: 13 Lawmakers Seek Federal Probe Into Seattle Diwali Event Disruption
end.line: Thirteen US lawmakers have asked the Department of Justice to investigate whether the disruption of a Diwali celebration in Seattle was a federal civil rights violation.
